The Guyot training system is a part of a group of systems referred to as a VSP system (vertical shoot positioned; other examples include the lyre system). The system was developed in France in the late 1800s and is named after Dr. Jules Guyot. The training system was designed for low to moderate vigor vineyards; it accommodates fewer buds and vine growth per linear foot of vineyard row than other training systems.
